notes.title: Small update: Fixing bugs and impelemting your feedback
notes.content:
Kind Nature Patch Notes – V 0.1.1 (28.08.2023)

Another month passed where we worked hard on the Kind Nature demo and implemented lots of your feedback and cool new stuff.

You can check all the new changes and bugfixes here:

New

 New Main Menu with a cozy survivor camp scene
 New Runner Look: Hunter has now a more fitting 3D Model
 New Enemies: We added wolves as enemies to the game
 New Boss Enemies: Boss Bruno of Cologne comes with two Doberman adds
 New cards: Parry Daggers! They deal counter damage when being attacked 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095104/46c2baaec1392bfddd8c8f1b5da2b5a13a54f6af.png
 More card animations in battles
 Cards that can be played have a small particle effect now
 Added researches for Activated Carbon, Shepherds Purse and Marigold 


Changes

 All cards are to be dragged now, not only attack cards, so it’s easier to understand
 Implemented a better outline shader
 Enemies will have an outline if you target them as better visual feedback
 Added more different outcomes to every choice in mission events
 Cologne card reward will give you Cloth Armor instead of Leather Armor now


Bug Fixes

 Strength buff will be now displayed correctly in enemy intentions
 If attack is higher through strength, icon will be yellow
 Lots of translation issues fixed
 Preview arrows on timeline won’t overlap completely anymore so you always know exactly who will attack first
 Added some missing researches
 Fixed a bug where sometimes one of the hand cards is smaller than the others


Gameplay Improvements

 Balanced Cologne enemies
 Cologne Boss enemy is a bit easier now
 End Turn Popup won’t show anymore if you don’t have any cards to play but still AP
 Increased amount of recyclable resources 


Other Changes

 Removed character stands from battles, since they don’t fit anymore
 Transition from mission to battle scene is now smoother
 Worked on the game over screen
 Added sound cue when card is not playable



Thank you for playing Kind Nature, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing.
You can reach us via mail at support@polypirates.com or on our discord server.

notes.title: Regular Update: Multiple Enemies, German localization and a visual overhaul
notes.content:
Kind Nature Patch Notes – V 0.1.0 (04.08.2023)

We have been working hard on Kind Nature for the last month and have many new updates for you. Besides being able to fight multiple enemies now and a complete visual overhaul, we also added a new language - German.

You can check all the new changes and bugfixes here:

New

 Multiple Enemies! Now battles are going to be tougher because you can encounter up to 3 enemies Note: Drag attack cards on the enemy you want to attack
 New language: German! Change the language in the main menu
 Added building models for camp buildings up to level 4
 Added Nature Points Note: They don’t do anything for now but will be very important later in the game
 Added more card animations to the battles


Changes

 Enemies intentions are displayed now at the start of their turn
 Lots and lots of enemy balancing
 Runner costs are increasing now after each card the Runner gets


Bug Fixes

 When recycling scrap it now gives the right amount
 When closing the camp tutorial with ESC, the menu won’t pop up now
 Removed required research for Runner Bag


Gameplay Improvements

 Added outlines to battle icons
 Removed the resource reward popup from missions


Other Changes

 Full rework of the event system! Choices can now have different outcomes
 Full rework of the enemy AI! Their behavior is now greatly improved
 Enemies have names now! (No Bandit_01 anymore)


Thank you for playing Kind Nature, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing.
You can reach us via mail at support@polypirates.com.

notes.title: Small Update: New Tutorial and more fixes
notes.content:
Kind Nature Patch Notes – V 0.0.5.1 (04.07.2023)

Another round of fixes, updates and improvements. Thank you so much for your feedback!

New


 Added a tutorial mission scene which will start when you first play the game.
 Added a small camp tutorial when you first enter the survivor camp. 
 Added a new Enemy: Female Bandit
 Added 3 new support cards:

 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44095104/80988284dda9c4b746717636ad305c1f33d07509.png

Now you are able to heal more during harder fights and counter poison and bleed
Please note: Support actions will always be played first when your character reaches ACT. Bleed and Poison damage will trigger later. So you can heal poison before getting poison damage etc. 

Changes


 Clicking on the camp buildings will now open the production menu as first tab, not the upgrade menu.
 Changed Starter Deck to: 2x Improvised Weapon, 4x Improvised Shield, 1x Simple Healing, 2x Small Pouch, 2x Pistol, 1x Bulbine Bandage, 2x Simple Dagger, 1x Luggage Strap
 Event decisions can now lead to the player taking damage 
 Increased scrap material gain when completing a mission.


Bug Fixes


 Fixed a bug where wrong researches where displayed on the Recycler overview.
 Fixed a bug where you didn’t get your Runner Points back when you win the fight while he is still away.
 Gameplay Improvements
 Poison damage will now be visible on the hp bar.
 Added speed value to cards.
 Added keyboard shortcuts to the Fight: Choose cards with keys 1-9, press Enter to end turn.
 All popups can be closed now with Enter.
 Added a speed up toggle to the menu. If it’s on, battles are played at 2x speed.
 When selecting cards, the arrow on top of cards display the card selection order


Other Changes


 Added new images to Intro making it now complete.
 Removed some hard to see details of camp buildings to give the scene a more cohesive look.


Thank you for playing Kind Nature, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing.
You can reach us via mail at support@polypirates.com or on our discord server.

notes.title: Regular Update: Usability
notes.content:
Kind Nature Patch Notes – V 0.0.5 (20.06.2023)

After another round of playtests, we fixed some more issues and implemented more feedback for players (tutorials, popups, etc.)

This is included in the new update:

New

 Boss Battle in Berlin has its own environment now
 Improved Main Menu and added links to all important sites
 Demo will now start with a mission 

Changes

 Added more cards to the starter deck: Simple Spear 1x, Simple Dagger 2x, Luggage Strap 1x, Comfrey Paste 1x
 Removed the following cards from starter deck: Improvised Weapon 2x, Small Pouch 1x, Bulbine Bandage 1x
 Bleed now triggers when it’s stacked on 5 instead on 10 and will do 5 damage
 Bandit enemies will no longer heal but instead use strength
 Nature Fanatic heal less and use more boost and slow

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where damage numbers where below zero
 Fixed caravan tab being still selected when trying to recycle cards leading to a bug

Gameplay Improvements

 The timeline now shows a preview of how fast you will reach the end in relation to your opponent
 End Turn Button is better clickable
 More information when crafting cards. Added Description, count in deck and caravan/bacis icon
 Runner now changes direction when being clicked to better indicate that he’s selected
 UI and Popups can be closed with ESC now
 Added some tips that will show up during fights
 Added Poison Tutorial popup

Other Changes

 Updated the intro with new graphics and some animations


Thank you for playing Kind Nature, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing.
You can reach us via mail at support@polypirates.com or on our discord server (verlinken).

notes.title: Closed Test: Berlin Update
notes.content:
Kind Nature Patch Notes – V 0.0.4 (05.06.2023)
We received lots of valuable feedback from you and will continue implementing it to the game. This is what we have for now:

New
•	Berlin is now playable as a new mission
•	Main Menu and first version of an intro scene
•	First version of a battle tutorial

Changes
•	Added a mission selection screen to campfire
•	New Enemy Models: Added 1 new Bandit and 1 new Nature Fanatic
•	Reworked some animations
•	Added a new Background for the Boss Battle in Cologne
•	Mission fields wont show up next to each other anymore to reduce confusion where to go next
•	Added individual Enemy Arrows: the right arrows are now shown on the timeline 
•	Changed the runner arrow
•	Added 3 new events with new decisions
•	Events now have the possibility to lose resources
•	Added more UI sounds
•	Added Game Won and Game Over jingles
•	Runner is now outlined when runner points are full

Bug Fixes
•	Caravan Cards (Equipment & Runner) have the right color now
•	Fixed battle popup visual bug
•	Fixed a bug where poison prevented the next action to play and freezing the battle
•	Fixed music continue to play when game over

Gameplay Improvements
•	More Caravan Cards: to have a better deckbuilding experience, we changed lots of base cards to caravan cards
•	Added more caravan cards to the starter deck
•	Basic cards are a bit weaker, but caravan cards stronger
•	Strength-effect is now displayed directly on the card
•	No longer fighting the same enemy twice within a mission 
•	Added descriptions of mission fields
•	Collected Runner Points now retain between fights
•	Increased Runner costs a bit
•	Current selected Tile is more visible now
•	Added card counter to deck

Performance Improvements
•	Mission Scene: Added performance boost, should be a lot smoother to play now
•	Camp Scene: Added GPU instancing for better performance
•	Reduced GC allocation in all scenes
•	Changed shadow quality

Other Changes
•	Lots of balancing! There are now two different missions with different difficulty levels
•	Worked on Lighting in Battle Scene
•	“Delete & Quit” Button is now better integrated in the menu
•	Resolution is now shown instead of quality
•	Added Desktop Icon

Thank you for playing Kind Nature, and we hope you enjoy the latest patch. Please don't hesitate to report any bugs or issues you encounter while playing.
